none.title: Hollow Grove
lines: The trees remember the wind before it came.
Moss drinks the morning like a secret.
No footsteps disturb the hush.

none.title: Whispering Pines
lines: The pines remember every step you’ve taken.
Morning breathes through the needles like a secret.
Stay quiet, and the forest will answer.

none.title: Whispering Pines
lines: The pines breathe in the morning mist.
Each leaf holds a forgotten name.
Listen closely—something remembers you.

none.title: Hollow Earth
lines: The world hums beneath your feet.
Fog remembers every name you've whispered.
Only the silent walk forever.

none.title: Beneath the Quiet
lines: The fog remembers every step you’ve never taken.
Quiet grows in the spaces between sounds.
Here, silence is not empty—it listens.

none.title: Whispering Hollow
lines: The moss remembers every whisper.
Dawn settles like a breath.
No footprints stay long.

sad.title: where the silence breathes
lines: The wind doesn't move here. It only listens.
Even silence has a name. It’s not empty.
You don’t have to speak. Just be still.

sad.title: where silence grows
lines: Silence doesn’t end. It just learns to breathe.
The snow remembers every sound you never made.
You are not alone. You are just not heard.

sad.title: between the breaths
lines: You don't have to speak to be seen here.
The silence isn't empty—it's listening.
Every breath is a bloom, and it knows your name.

sad.title: whispering hollow
lines: The grass remembers how to breathe.
You don’t have to speak. Just be here.
Every petal holds a name you forgot.

sad.title: whispering hollow
lines: The ground remembers every fall.
You don’t have to speak. Just be here.
The petals don’t move—only breathe.

sad.title: Where the silence lives
lines: The world doesn’t speak here. It listens.
You didn’t come to be heard. You came to be seen.
Even the wind knows your name.

shuffled.title: Hollowed Light
lines: The light remembers what you forget.
Every shadow has a name.
Only the quiet can see the truth.
Walk in the hollow, and speak to the glass.
You are not lost—you are becoming.

shuffled.title: Between the Words
lines: The air hums with unspoken things.
Each leaf carries a name you never said.
Bubbles hold the silence between us.

shuffled.title: Between Words
lines: The air tastes like an unfinished name.
Each petal holds a sentence half-spoken.
Walk where the words breathe in.
Beyond the bridge, silence is a syllable.

shuffled.title: Whispering Hollow
lines: The wind speaks in petals.
Each step makes a soft breath.
You are always remembered here.

shuffled.title: Between the Notes
lines: The air hums with forgotten words.
Each breath is a new verse.
You are always just after the next note.
There is no end to the pause between sounds.

shuffled.title: Between the Words
lines: The air is full of words that haven’t been spoken.
Between pages, the world breathes.
Listen — the wind is reading you.
